caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain, 23 kt Winds Near Roatan
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing moist tropical flow with sustained winds near 23 kt, seas to 4.5 ft and an ENE dominant swell at an 8 s period, and I am monitoring heavy rain (88% rain probability) that will reduce visibility and produce localized runoff. I recommend that cruise and port operators treat conditions off Roatan as Small Craft Advisory-level, restrict small-boat movements and prepare for reduced transfer operations; nearby Martinique is much quieter with winds around 12 kt and minimal sea impact.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos Winds and Choppy Seas Threaten Small Vessels
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing northerly winds up to 24 kt with seas to 5.4 ft and a dominant NNE swell at a 7 s period, with less than 10% rain probability. I note Marseille has lighter winds near 19 kt, but I advise small-boat operators to exercise caution around Mykonos where 24 kt winds and 5.4 ft seas will produce choppy conditions and frequent gusts.
